needed.evidence: A wide, mown grass verge runs from the road edge to the houses, with no paved or trodden path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a paved footway along the left verge to provide a safe, continuous route for residents.

needed.evidence: The right side of the road is a grassy area leading to driveways and houses, with no dedicated path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Install a footway on the right side to connect the residential properties to the street safely.

needed.evidence: The road is a residential street with houses on both sides, creating a high demand for crossing, but there is no marked or physical crossing facility visible.
needed.suggestion: Provide a raised, marked pedestrian crossing at a logical point to allow safe passage between the houses on either side.

needed.evidence: There are no street lights visible along the length of the road in any of the frames.
needed.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for all users during the evening and night.
